description: This file defines the 'Edit' controller class for the account section of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles rendering the account edit page and processing form submissions to update user information, including validation and session management.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Controller class for editing customer account information in OpenCart, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the account edit form, populating it with customer data and preparing navigation/breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submitted account edit form, performs validation, updates customer data, and manages session information.
